latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of case-writer-hybrid.

- Converts structured briefs into first-draft long-form markdown articles with reusable sidecar files.
- Integrates a local writer/critic/humanizer/judge quality loop, with automatic quality gate enforcement after up to 3 rounds.
- Outputs both the article draft and supporting sidecars for downstream image generation and WeChat formatting.
- Prioritizes user-supplied arguments and materials, preserving original structure and intent.
- Halts workflow and emits a notice if drafts do not pass quality thresholds.
